items.name: biological_truth_annotation
items.note: Biological reference-stream states, unresolved handling and event-id semantics are frozen before held-out scoring.

items.name: coupling_truth_annotation
items.note: Target-coupled causal-attribution states, positive consistency rule and unresolved handling are frozen.

items.name: nuisance_truth_annotation
items.note: Exogenous nuisance truth is frozen as positive multi-label process effects with target-driven response excluded.

items.name: support_truth_annotation
items.note: Five component support states and the failed/unresolved/compromised/observable aggregation order are frozen.

items.name: split_blinding_protocol
items.note: Truth-layer blinding invariants and minimum double-annotation rules are frozen inside the truth artifact, but the realised development/held-out block allocation remains tied to the final sampling plan and dataset manifest.

items.name: o_measurement_calibration
items.note: Five-component O estimator exists; 0.30/0.70 remain development defaults, not field-calibrated thresholds.

items.name: target_field_adapter
items.note: PolliPi main ordinal 0/0.5/1 target-evidence mapping is frozen as a positive-only direct target route with cross-repository provenance; low evidence cannot be inverted into absence and no coupled evidence is invented.

items.name: coupled_field_adapter
items.note: A local-response field measurement baseline now exists and fails closed to usable C=0 without an independently calibrated attribution cue. The concrete field attribution source/calibration and final manifest binding remain unfrozen.

items.name: nuisance_field_adapter
items.note: Primary-stream continuous process measurement baseline exists. It is uncalibrated and must not be treated as nuisance probability or held-out-frozen risk mapping.

items.name: target_nuisance_decision_calibration
items.note: Operational target high/low, nuisance high and the mapping from field nuisance measurements to false-event/missed-event/attribution risks must be frozen from development-only data before held-out decisions.

items.name: forced_vs_certified_absence_metrics
items.note: Forced and certified absence formulas, denominators and zero-denominator behavior are frozen before held-out scoring.

items.name: cluster_exposure_estimand
items.note: Primary estimand is frozen as detected unique visit events per interpretable primary-stream hour; censored time is not no-visit exposure.

items.name: sampling_power_plan
items.note: A parameterized cluster-aware precision/power calculation method exists. Final MESI, endpoint assumptions, ICC, cluster count, split rule and hashes remain to be frozen before held-out scoring.

items.name: claim_thresholds
items.note: Claim families, directions and confidence-bound decision semantics are defined. Numerical thresholds remain intentionally null and must be justified, completed and hashed before held-out scoring.
